mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, product_id, content, read_flag) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{productId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u.display_name AS sender_name FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.sender_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY m.created_at

SELECT m.*, u.display_name AS sender_name FROM chat_message m JOIN ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(id) AS last_id FROM chat_message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY conversation_id ) latest ON latest.last_id = m.id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.sender_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET read_flag = 1 WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0
